questions.prompt: A bus's velocity changes from 10 m/s to 30 m/s in 5 seconds. What is its average acceleration?
questions.explanation: Average acceleration a = (v - u) / t = (30 - 10) / 5 = 20/5 = 4 m/s².

questions.prompt: An object moves with uniform acceleration. Which graph correctly represents its velocity vs. time?
options: A straight line with constant non-zero slope
questions.explanation: Uniform acceleration means dv/dt is constant. The v-t graph is a straight line whose slope equals the (constant) acceleration. A horizontal line means zero acceleration (uniform motion).

questions.prompt: A car decelerates uniformly from 25 m/s to rest in 5 s. Its acceleration is:
questions.explanation: a = (v - u) / t = (0 - 25) / 5 = -5 m/s². The negative sign indicates the acceleration vector opposes the direction of motion — this is deceleration.
